title: Ordinary verification/build subprocess scheduling: qualify scoped CPU and I/O policy
outcome: Heavy owned verification/build trees yield resources to interactive TermAl under a measured Windows/macOS policy, with unchanged verification/cleanup semantics and an agreed bounded wall-time cost; if no candidate meets both goals, record rejection rather than silently applying it.
acceptance: Record the current launch paths and an independently concurred platform policy/coverage matrix for full/focused stages, dependency bootstrap and landing release builds. State CPU versus IO mechanisms, application point before heavy code, effective descendant/fixture behavior, unsupported/error behavior and exact ownership boundary. No unrelated host/agent/global changes; existing concurrency/installation/restart authority remains.

Any approved implementation reuses existing process owner/launcher paths, preserves arguments/env/cwd/stage inventory/assertions/timeouts/retries/test-thread/worker/load bounds and native exits/artifacts/fingerprints. Records requested AND observed policy/capability and failure in run/build evidence. Guardians/control/result settlement stay responsive; no silent fallback, privilege escalation or unowned process mutation.

Native deterministic coverage on Windows/macOS checks policy application/readback, descendant ownership, unsupported/failure handling, interruption and sibling/host isolation. Timing/performance/stress oracles keep a relevant unchanged-load validation; old failed runs and original profile remain preserved and independently diagnosed, never closed because a lower-priority run passes.

BEFORE experiment, coordinator/Architect2 concur numeric responsiveness/slowdown budgets and a bounded comparable same-input/cache/load baseline/candidate plan covering full gate AND release build on each affected platform. Report phase/resource/cadence limits; no empirical benefit claimed from existing two ticks. Reject/defer adoption if goals cannot both be met; no retry-until-green or timeout inflation.

Relevant focused validation, independent pair with no Medium+, and exact-input maintained full gate precede any landing; document policy/platform/evidence limits and rollback through the existing owner. A priority policy does not repair logical lock/deadlock or persistence defects and does not waive S2/C3 release evidence.
